text: Mai is pregnant! Due March 2027. She's only told family so far, so keep it quiet for now.
Remind me to text Hemi the day before his puppy's first vet visit on June 3rd. He's worried she won't settle in the car.
Kwame and his wife are having the christening on 2 November 2026 at St Mary's. Their little boy is called Joseph after his grandad.
Valentina's cat Pepper has been off her food all week. Vet thinks it might be her kidneys. Results back Thursday.
Bumped into Pieter at the park with his new puppy, a beagle called Rolo. Twelve weeks old and already chewing everything.
Need to buy a card for Jen's baby shower on May 14. She said they're doing a woodland theme.

Nia had her twelve week scan yesterday and everything looks fine. She's due in early April. Her mum is already knitting. She told me her partner Karim cried at the scan, and they're thinking about finding out the sex at the twenty week one in December. She's been really tired but says the nausea has mostly stopped.
Call with Oliver. His dog Biscuit turns ten on 5/14 and he's throwing her a little party with a pupcake. Honestly sounds adorable.
Don't forget to ask Emil how the christening went. It was on Sunday and his sister was godmother.
Joy said the gender reveal is off. They decided it felt too much like a performance, so they're just going to announce it at Christmas instead.
Pick up flea treatment and a new scratching post this weekend.

Finn's partner Sophie gave birth on October 12th! A girl, 3.2 kg, called Ivy. Finn sounded absolutely exhausted but over the moon. They're home now and Sophie's mum is staying with them for the first fortnight. Finn goes back to work on November 2nd and is already dreading it. Remind me to send a meal delivery voucher the week after he goes back, when things will be hardest.
I should send something to Karim the week after the baby arrives. He mentioned they're short on muslins and bibs.
Ali's rabbit Clover had to be put to sleep this morning. He's really cut up about it. Remind me to check in with him that evening.

Emily is expecting twins! Due date is June 3rd, but the midwife said twins usually come early. She's nervous about the birth and about how they'll manage with two. Her husband has asked for extended leave but hasn't heard back from his boss yet. She's set up the cots already and showed me photos of the nursery, all pale green with little foxes.
Aisha told me her brother Milan and his wife just adopted a rescue greyhound called Dash. Apparently it sleeps nineteen hours a day.
Eduardo loves birdwatching and has been trying to spot a kingfisher all summer. Might be a nice gift idea, a decent pair of binoculars.

Lin's christening is March 2027 because they want her grandparents to be able to fly over from Taipei. Remind me to book the hotel the week before. Her husband Thomas is handling the church side and says there'll be a lunch afterwards at his parents' house. Lin wants me to do a reading, which I'm honoured by but also slightly terrified about.
Thomas and Gemma are both vegetarian, and Gemma can't do dairy either. Worth remembering for the dinner.

Long chat with Lukas tonight. His parrot Mango is turning twenty-five on 2 November 2026, which he says is middle-aged for an African grey. He's thinking about getting a bigger cage and asked if I knew anyone selling one. He also mentioned his girlfriend Erin is starting a midwifery course in January and is a bit anxious about the placements.
Ethan's cat is having surgery on Tuesday to remove a lump. Text him that evening to see how she got on.
Meera says her sister is due any day now. She's planning to drive down to Leeds the moment she hears anything.
Sadia's baby boy arrived early, on 9/28. Both doing well. They're calling him Yusuf.

Remind me to drop off the casserole for Georgia the day after she gets home from hospital. She's had a rough recovery after the C-section. She's been in for five days because of an infection. Her mum is looking after the older two in the meantime, and their dog Hector has gone to a neighbour. She said she's fed up of hospital food more than anything.
Layla's dog Teddy went missing on Saturday. Still no sign of him. She's put posters up all over Hillfield.
Book the car in for its MOT before November 20th.
Mandla is godfather to his best friend's son. The christening was meant to be May 14 but they've pushed it back to June 3rd because the vicar's ill.
Jen mentioned she'd love a proper baby carrier, the ergonomic kind. Possible gift for after the birth.

Oliver and Mai have been trying for a baby for nearly two years. They're starting IVF in the new year. Don't bring it up unless she does. Mai said the waiting and the injections are the hardest part, and Oliver is trying to stay positive for both of them. First appointment is January 8th. I should send her something small that week, just so she knows I'm thinking of her.
Must ring Pieter the morning of his wife's induction. It's booked for 11/3 at the Royal.
Valentina is fostering kittens for the local shelter again. Four this time, all ginger.
Spoke to Uncle Hemi on the phone. He's retiring on 2 November 2026 after thirty years at the port. Then he wants to get a dog.
Kwame's daughter Nia starts nursery the week after the christening. He's more nervous about it than she is.
I'm taking Joy to her first antenatal class on Wednesday. Need to remember to leave by six.
Need to send Emil a congratulations card. His wife had the baby last week and I completely forgot.
Finn's mum is turning seventy on March 3rd. He wants to do something low key at home.
Karim got a cockapoo puppy called Pudding. He said the first week has been chaos, no sleep at all.
Ali and his husband are expecting via surrogacy. Baby due 2 November 2026. They've asked me to be a guardian, which I need to think about properly.
Remind me to ask Emily how the hospital tour went. It was this afternoon.
Aisha is allergic to cats but still somehow ended up with one. Says the antihistamines are working.
Haven't heard back from the vet about the vaccination booster. Ring them first thing Monday.
Eduardo Fernández's tortoise Señor Speedy is eighty this year. Older than Eduardo's dad.
Joseph Baker from work is going on paternity leave from June 3rd for two weeks. His wife Lin is due at the end of May. I should organise a collection the week before he goes.

Milan's cat Smudge got hit by a car on Friday night. She survived but needs an operation on her back leg. He sounded shaken. The operation is booked for Wednesday at the emergency vet in town and will cost a fortune. His girlfriend Aisha is starting a fundraiser among friends. Remind me to chip in and to message him the day after the surgery to see how Smudge is doing.
Thomas mentioned he and his partner had a miscarriage in the summer. He's doing okay now but it's been a hard year for them.
Note to self: Lukas said Erin's waters broke at 3am. She's at the hospital now. Text him tomorrow, not tonight.
Sophie's dog Bella had six puppies on Tuesday night! She's keeping one and finding homes for the rest. She asked if I want one, which I definitely do not.
Remind me to text Ethan good luck the night before his presentation to the adoption panel on May 14. He and Gemma have been waiting almost a year.

Meera's grandmother is turning ninety-five in March 2027. The whole family is flying in from Mumbai. Meera's in charge of the cake and slightly panicking. She's thinking of doing three tiers with marigolds on top. Her brother Milan is sorting flights for their aunties and says it's a full time job. The party is the Saturday after the birthday itself.
Erin's baby shower is cancelled because she's on bed rest. She's fine, just being careful. I should drop round with snacks and magazines.
Sadia said her husband's brother just had a baby girl. They're all going over to Manchester for the naming ceremony on 11/16.
Bought a birthday hat for my own dog. He's going to hate it.
Georgia and Layla are moving in together on October 31st. Georgia's cat and Layla's dog have never met, so wish them luck.
Gemma's due date is 6/3 and her bump is huge already. She's craving pickles and grapefruit, which she finds hilarious. Her husband Ethan is painting the nursery this weekend.
Pieter's son had his first birthday on Saturday. Big party, far too many balloons. I left early to beat traffic.
Mandla said his dog Zulu needs a new home because they're moving abroad on 2 December 2026. Remind me to ask Hemi, he's been wanting a big dog.

Mai's twins are due 5/14, but she's booked in for a C-section the week before. Remind me to send flowers the day after. She's had a rough third trimester with terrible heartburn and swollen ankles, and she's been signed off work since September. Her mum is moving in for the first month, which Mai has mixed feelings about.
Jen's hamster died. Her daughter is devastated. Apparently they're having a little garden funeral tomorrow.
Valentina and her partner are naming the baby Rosa after her great-aunt. Christening probably in spring, no date yet.
Quick call with Kwame. All good. Nothing new really.
